name: full-loop.v1
description: Longitudinal multi-capture scenarios: bucket and memory state evolve across captures and corrections. scriptedThoughts make the deterministic (no-gateway) mode exact — model quality is scored by the stage evals; here we score the plumbing (provenance, placement, hard rule, adherence) and, in live mode, the real models end to end.

cases.description: Three captures over a week: an onboarding bucket forms, a task lands in Tasks, a correction moves an experiment idea to Growth Experiments, and a later similar thought follows the correction.
